validated_results.title: Effects of Docosahexaenoic Acid on Prostate Cancer.
validated_results.reason: The article is explicitly a narrative review discussing DHA effects on prostate cancer based on in vitro and in vivo evidence rather than an original human study.

validated_results.title: The health burden of disease attributable to low calcium intake: a comprehensive analysis of trends and socioeconomic impacts from 1990 to 2021.
validated_results.reason: This Global Burden of Disease analysis of low calcium intake reports only deaths, DALYs, ASMR, ASDR, and forecast trends, with no prostate cancer incidence estimate.

validated_results.title: Interpretable machine learning approaches for predicting prostate cancer by using multiple heavy metal exposures based on the data from NHANES 2003-2018.
validated_results.reason: The NHANES machine-learning analysis predicts prevalent prostate cancer classification from cross-sectional heavy metal measurements rather than estimating incident prostate cancer risk.
